name: Stage 28: Strångsjövägen to Viggaren
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 28, Strångsjövägen to Viggaren.
utilities: Stage 28 is an official 10 km Strångsjövägen-Viggaren stage through easy forest paths/roads, moraine ground, eskers, Hönstorpasjön, Sundstugan/Solbacken context and Glindranåsen reserve.
Parking is very limited: official text says 2-3 cars at both ends and a few cars mid-stage near the Sundstugan/gravel-road crossing. Treat these as small pull-offs rather than formal lots.
Hönstorpasjön area is the main on-stage rest/facility area: first the lake-view rest section, then roughly 1 km later the bathing/shelter/grill/toilet cluster.
Solbackens småbruk near Sundstugan can be useful for seasonal self-pick/cafe context and occasional water/fika when open, but it is private/seasonal and should not be treated as guaranteed.

Public transport is weak at the trailheads. Use Sörmlandstrafiken live planning and expect road walk, taxi, bike, car, or book-ahead rural/complementary traffic rather than a simple bus-to-trailhead hike. Strångsjö and Glindran stops are wider-area access contexts, not close trailhead stops.
waterSources: The current official stage water point is the Glindraåsen spring/source at about 7.5 km. It is also mapped in OSM, but Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee quality/flow; filter/boil/treat and carry backup.

Older/third-party and OSM sources list an early drinking-water point near Strångsjövägen. A 2022 hiker report describes a cold concrete well with a wooden lid and clear but slightly brown water after awkward clearcut/brush access, but the current official stage page lists only Glindraåsen; show it only as unverified/seasonal legacy context.

Hönstorpasjön and Viggaren are natural lake water only. Treat surface water and do not present lake access as potable refill. Hönstorpasjön water has been described as brown/humic and poor-tasting even after filtering.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official distance is 10 km; local official-GPX geometry is about 9.6 km, Naturkartan metadata is about 9.8 km, OSM relation 3924910 geometry is about 9.8 km, while older/Naturkartan prose/OSM relation distance tag/Grillplatser can show about 11.5 km. Use 10 km official and treat 11.5 km as stale or loop-derived metadata.

Official difficulty is lättgången/easy. Expect managed forest, forest roads, some uneven/stony or vehicle-rutted patches, lake views, pasture/juniper landscape and a gravel-road finish along Viggaren. Team Vildmark's 2020 report described it as pleasant but not very wild, with fine torp sites, Storsjön/Hönstorpasjön views and nice ending terrain near Glindranåsen/Viggaren.

Official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass; Länsstyrelsen Glindranåsen showed no current reserve news but did display a current Södermanland forest-fire-risk notice. VSR had no formal Katrineholm/Vingåker fire ban at check time but warned of high/large fire risk, so use fixed fireplaces only after day-of checks.

Glindranåsen/Glindraåsen naming varies by source. Reserve rules found online are minimal but include not extracting gravel/stone/sand/soil from the esker; protected-area signs and fire bans override general guidance. The current online reserve rule set did not list a separate camping ban, so apply allemansrätten unless local signs say otherwise.

No designated tent site is listed for stage 28. Use the Hönstorpasjön shelter as the practical overnight/rest point, or low-impact one-night tenting only where appropriate under allemansrätten and local signs.

User reports since 2015 mention uneven/stony first kilometers, cycle ruts, planted forest, clearcuts and forestry debris; Forssjö-loop comments overlapping/shared with Stage 28 mention heavy forestry impact in 2023/2025 and high vegetation in 2024. Treat these as trail-character/seasonal-maintenance cautions, not current official closures.

Related Forssjö loop comments mention a 2025 deteriorated/overgrown rest spot at Viggaren/Gustav Höglunds stuga. Treat as local caution, not an official stage-28 closure; do not rely on maintained seating there.

Do not merge or draw the Forssjö loop/OSM relation 8309519 into Stage 28. OSM shows it sharing only a few Stage 28 ways and official text says the loop is partly on Stage 28; treat overlap as coincident route membership, not a Stage 28 branch.

OSM relation 3924910 is topologically continuous with Stage 27 at about 58.928796, 16.267331 and Stage 29 at about 58.876279, 16.351303. Snap drawn route continuity to shared OSM nodes while keeping official Sörmlandsleden endpoint labels.

No official railway crossing was found for Stage 28. Road hazards are ordinary live-road/gravel-road sections, especially the road-following segment near Viggaren, the Sundstugan gravel-road access and the Strångsjövägen endpoint.
In early spring, dead grass can dry quickly before new growth. Check SMHI/MSB Brandrisk Ute and local fire bans before using grills or stoves.

Do not assume free fishing in Hönstorpasjön or Viggaren. Hönstorpasjön appears in Ericsberg's listed fishing waters; Viggaren permit status was not verified, so confirm fishing-right holder/permit rules locally before fishing.

facilities.name: Strångsjövägen stage start
facilities.description: Official stage start with very limited roadside/small pull-off parking, about 2-3 cars according to Sörmlandsleden.

facilities.name: Legacy early spring near Strångsjövägen
facilities.description: Older/third-party sources and OSM list a drinking-water point near the start. A 2022 hiker report described a cold concrete well with a wooden lid but awkward clearcut/brush access; the current official stage page does not list it. Treat as unverified/seasonal legacy context and carry water.

facilities.name: Hönstorpasjön view/rest section
facilities.description: Lake-view rest context before/around the Hönstorpasjön shelter/bathing area. Good pause point, not a separate service guarantee.

facilities.name: Hönstorpasjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter/rest node by Hönstorpasjön; OSM lean-to is very close. Shared first-come shelter; no firewood, bin or dedicated tent-space guarantee.

facilities.name: Hönstorpasjön fireplace/grill
facilities.description: Prepared fire/grill context at the shelter/bathing area. Use only when current fire rules allow; no firewood guarantee.

facilities.name: Hönstorpasjön toilet
facilities.description: Official page lists toilet at/near the Hönstorpasjön bathing area; OSM node 8781266621 maps a nearby toilet. Verify condition on arrival.

facilities.name: Hönstorpasjön bathing
facilities.description: Bathing/lake rest at or near the shelter area. Not a guaranteed monitored bathing place; treat lake water before drinking.

facilities.name: Hönstorpasjön picnic table
facilities.description: OSM picnic table at the Hönstorpasjön shelter/fireplace/bathing cluster. Rest option only; no bin or potable-water guarantee.

facilities.name: Stage 28 forestry/overgrowth caution
facilities.description: User reports mention clearcuts, forestry debris, uneven/cycle-rutted early sections and 2024-2025 overgrowth/forestry complaints on overlapping Forssjö-loop areas. Treat as seasonal trail-character caution rather than an official closure.

facilities.name: Sundstugan gravel-road parking context
facilities.description: Mid-stage gravel-road crossing near Sundstugan/Solbacken where official text says a few cars can park. Check local signs and avoid blocking access.

facilities.name: Solbackens småbruk seasonal self-pick/cafe
facilities.description: Seasonal private self-pick/cafe context near Sundstugan. Current site lists self-pick July-August weekends 11-15 and summer cafe in July weekends 11-15; official comments mention possible water refill/fika when open. Verify opening before relying on it.

facilities.name: Glindraåsen spring/source
facilities.description: Official stage water point after about 7.5 km; OSM drinking-water node 2989517361 is almost identical. Natural/untested source: quality and availability are not guaranteed, so treat/filter/boil and carry backup.

facilities.name: Lisstorpsblocken side trip
facilities.description: Short detour to distinctive boulders near/in Glindranåsen; useful geology/nature highlight rather than a facility.

facilities.name: Glindranåsen reserve warning
facilities.description: Esker reserve context along the Glindranåsen/Glindraåsen stretch. The current online rule set prohibits extracting gravel/stone/sand/soil from the esker and does not list a separate camping ban; posted reserve signs and fire bans override general guidance.

facilities.name: Forssjö loop overlap caution
facilities.description: Rundslinga Forssjö shares a few Stage 28 ways but is a separate loop/OSM relation. Do not merge the full loop into the Stage 28 route-builder line.

facilities.name: Forssjö natur- och kulturmuseum context
facilities.description: Nearby Forssjö loop/start context with parking/information/rest-area and charcoal/forge/cultural-history features. Useful side context only; not part of the Stage 28 mainline.

facilities.name: Viggaren stage end
facilities.description: Stage 28 end and stage 29 start by/near Lake Viggaren. Official parking is only 2-3 cars/roadside context, not a formal large lot.

facilities.name: Viggaren rest-place caveat
facilities.description: Related Forssjö-loop comments in 2025 reported the Gustav Höglunds stuga/Viggaren rest spot as deteriorated or overgrown. Scenic context, but do not rely on maintained seating; this is a caution rather than a closure.

facilities.name: Strångsjö village services
facilities.description: Off-route Strångsjö village service cluster at Strångsjövägen 1: Nobless Grillen, 24food shop, ATM, DinX fuel/customer parking per Nobless site. Restaurant says Tue-Sun 11-20, Monday closed. About 3.9 km from the Stage 28 line; do not present as trailhead service.

facilities.name: Strångsjö wider bus access
facilities.description: Wider-area Strångsjö bus context around line 483, roughly 5 km by road from the Stage 28 start. Not a close trailhead stop; verify Sörmlandstrafiken live and expect weekday/sparse service.

facilities.name: Glindran wider bus access
facilities.description: Wider-area Glindran bus context around line 484, roughly 4 km from the Viggaren end. Very sparse service; verify Sörmlandstrafiken live before relying on it.

facilities.name: No verified Stage 28 bins
facilities.description: No waste bin was verified at Strångsjövägen, Hönstorpasjön, Sundstugan/Solbacken, Glindraåsen, Glindranåsen or Viggaren. Carry out all waste.
